facts.claim: Layout unchanged from Classic; loot revamped.
facts.notes: Planning notes call this multi-source but did not record the sites; treated as single-source until re-checked.

quests.claim: Corrupted Kor Gem drops from Tide Priestesses/Oracles outside and Sea Witches inside.
Damp Note from Tide Priestesses starts Allegiance to the Old Gods (kill Lorgus Jett); needs The Essence of Aku'Mai in your log. Known bug: not every party member can loot it.
Argent Guard Thaelrid inside gives Horde Blackfathom Villainy; turn in to Bashana Runetotem, Thunder Bluff.
quests.notes: Planning notes call this multi-source but did not record the sites; treated as single-source until re-checked.

quests.claim: The Fathom Core tablet (under the walkway to Kelris) completes Amongst the Ruins and summons Baron Aquanis, who drops the Strange Water Globe (reported ~93–100%) that starts Baron Aquanis.
quests.notes: Planning notes call this multi-source but did not record the sites; treated as single-source until re-checked.

bosses.claim: Twilight Lord Kelris: Sleep (5 yd) and Mind Blast. Light the braziers one at a time; each spawns a wave.
bosses.notes: Planning notes call this multi-source but did not record the sites; treated as single-source until re-checked. Will of the Forsaken breaks Sleep (Undead racial).

bosses.claim: Aku'mai: Poison Cloud ticks 527 Nature (was 50) — move out. Frenzied Rage: +75% attack speed.
Martyr's Chain (mail chest, +9 Str, +9 Sta, 420 Holy damage when you die) drops in BFD. Which boss drops it is not confirmed.
